proposal.hypothesis: A factor-two target mapping reuses each source particle load across two independent target accumulations. A 192-thread block (384 targets per block) tests a midpoint launch size; register use and occupancy effects are uncertain, and prior factor-two measurements were slower than baseline, so no speedup is assumed.

retained: Assign two target particles to each thread, with the second index offset by blockDim.x; maintain separate force accumulators and self-interaction checks.
Load each source particle once per loop iteration and reuse its position and mass for both valid target calculations.
Set the launch to 192 threads and 384 logical outputs per block, with zero shared-memory allocation.
Bounds-check and store the second target only when valid, covering arbitrary N and partial final blocks.
